verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a first-party Mobile Payments SDK page titled "Offline Payments" for Android, which suggests Square supports taking payments without connectivity. The pack gives only the page title, with no detail on how transactions are stored or forwarded, and the general docs frame processing around Internet-connected devices. Missing for 10: documented store-and-forward behavior and sync on reconnect, offline limits and risk terms, coverage beyond the Android SDK (iOS, Square hardware/POS app), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
